title: Normalized reconstruction of composites of completed operations
statement:
Let $A,I,P_n$, the constant pro-etale module categories $D(T,A)$, strict reduction functors $\mathcal R_T$, diagram categories $D(\mathcal T_T)$ and completion reflectors $C_T$ be as follows: $A$ is commutative Noetherian, $I$ is finitely generated, $A/I$ is additive torsion, and $P_n=A/I^n$ is finite and perfect for every $n\geq1$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum]; $T$ ranges over schemes with the small pro-etale sites and constant coefficient sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$, and $\mathcal R_T(M)=\Delta M\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}(\underline{P_n}_T)_n$ on its diagram site [def-weil-inverse-system, lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Write $\mathcal L_T=R\lim$ for the total right derived inverse-limit functor and $C_T=\mathcal L_T\mathcal R_T$ with its specified completion unit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit, lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. All direct images and inverse images use the canonical derived adjunctions on these constant-module categories.

Consider a finite composable word $W_c=F_m\cdots F_1$ on complete objects, in which each $F_i$ is either completed inverse image $u_c^*=C_Uu^*$ for a scheme map $u:U\to V$, derived direct image $Ru_*$, or completed open extension $J_j^c=C_VJ_j$ for an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow V$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback, lem-sf-cbc-extension-zero-completion]. Let $\widetilde F_i$ be respectively termwise inverse image $G_u$, total derived termwise direct image $R_u^{\mathcal T}$, or termwise open extension $J_j$, and put $\widetilde W=\widetilde F_m\cdots\widetilde F_1$. There are specified natural isomorphisms
$$q_{W,K}:\mathcal R(W_cK)\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde W\mathcal R(K),\qquad a_{W,K}:W_cK\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L(\widetilde W\mathcal R(K)).$$
For one letter, $q$ is the inverse of reduction of the completion unit followed by the strict pullback/tensor comparison, the diagram-site counit-tensor projection-formula map for direct image, or the map $q_{j,K}$ for completed open extension. For the empty word $q=1$ and $a$ is the complete object's completion unit. For a concatenation $VW$, the normalization is
$$q_{VW,K}=(\widetilde Vq_{W,K})\circ q_{V,W_cK},\qquad a_{W,K}=\mathcal L(q_{W,K})\circ\eta_{W_cK}.$$
Thus these are comparisons in derived strict-diagram categories, independent of parenthesization, not merely identifications of evaluated objects. For direct image, $a$ agrees with the canonical direct-image/derived-limit comparison normalized by tower projections [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison]. No uniform cohomological or Tor interval on $K$ or on intermediate objects is required; every assertion is in the ambient complete categories. No compactification, exchange-pasting equation, or faithfulness of derived evaluations is assumed.
